doc.title: Wendell Harrison interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 17, 2022 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Thanks and goodbyes
summary: Rowe thanks Harrison, who jokes about Rowe's name, and they sign off.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: This has been interesting for me, and I want to thank you for these great conversations and I hope you never run out of crayons in your crayon box.
I appreciate that, I appreciate that, Monk. You’ve got the right name, too.
You’ve got the right name. The priest of jazz, the Monk. I love it.
Thank you very much for your time, Wendell.
